title: Our Black Friday deal is here!
content:
All courses are reduced to £124.50, saving 50% off their full price of £249.

Every Black Friday is important for independents like us, but this year it's especially important

It's been…a year, huh? For independent publishers like us, it's been nothing short of disastrous, as I summarised a few weeks ago. I'm being deliberately blunt here because I don't think people realise how bad things have gotten, even compared to last year.

We all know the why: generative AI has completely taken over the industry and that might have triggered thoughts like "I don't need to bother learning now because I've got an LLM". I don't think that's a viable, long term viewpoint though.

Look, I get it, the technology really can feel like it's a miracle machine, but it's important to take a wider view. Along with the published studies on cognitive decline and the widening skills gap, it's more important than ever to invest in your brain to keep your skills sharp because you're not getting that repetitive reinforcement that writing code every day gives you anymore.

If you're using an LLM for work every day — either by choice or by mandate — you should theoretically have a lot more time to invest in your learning and personal development. If you're a boss reading this, you should be giving your developers more time to learn, rather than chasing endless volume. It's going to avoid burnout which yep, daily LLM use will likely cause in the long term. I wrote in more detail about where we currently are and how to navigate the future over on CSS-Tricks last week too, which I encourage bosses to read, especially.

Black Friday really is the most important time of year for educators, so we'd be delighted if you could consider our three excellent courses, including JavaScript for Everyone, which has just had a huge update. Know that funds from every course purchase are equally distributed between author and publisher here and everything we, the publisher take, is immediately invested back into providing great education for the community.

At the end of the day, if we stop, we lose, so support from the industry and community is essential and hugely appreciated.

Purchasing Power Parity (PPP)

Our PPP discounts are always based on the full price of the course, so our system will work out which deal is going to be the best for you.

If your PPP discount is cheaper than our Black Friday deal, we'll present that. If the Black Friday deal is cheaper, we'll present that.

We're all about people getting incredibly high quality education that's as affordable as possible.

Check it out!
author: Andy Bell
